stories.title: ‘People’s dignity, and democracy, is at stake’: meet the economist ditching ideology for reality
summary: Exclusive: Isabella Weber prescribes a common-sense solution to poverty, inequality and fascism – making life’s essentials affordable for allThe trouble with economists, Isabella Weber believes, is they do not behave like dentists.

As she sees it, the symptoms could not be more severe. “The status quo for the majority is entirely unbearable,” while extreme inequality and corporate concentration has reached levels “simply incompatible with democracy” worldwide.
All the while the far right is making hay.
